subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Dinner
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our annual Employee Appreciation Dinner taking place on Friday, December 10th at 7:00 PM in the main conference hall. This year, we have planned a special evening filled with delicious food, entertainment, and recognition of outstanding achievements. Please RSVP by November 30th to secure your spot. We look forward to celebrating together! Best regards, [Company Name]
